correctness.rationale: The acting group is exactly the 384 coordinate permutations and bit translations: after translating the image of zero back, an automorphism permutes the four singletons, and a vertex of higher weight is determined by its set of singleton neighbors at minimum distance. In the barycentric subdivision, each chain vertex has a distinct face cardinality. If two points of the same closed flag simplex are identified, the group element must take the positive support to itself rank by rank and preserve all coefficients, so the cell closure embeds. This gives the claimed regular CW orbit model with distinct facets obtained by deleting the ranked vertices. A chain with terminal face of size k is an ordered partition of that face into its nonempty increments, giving an independent total flag count. The separate replay checked every supplied representative and orbit for disjointness and coverage (742 nonempty faces, 2,199,938 flags, 6,721 orbit cells with the stated dimension vector). It rebuilt all signed-rank-independent facet incidences and replayed all 3,360 pairs in order: both cells were live and the face was a facet with a unique live immediate coface. In each embedded simplex closure there would be at least two immediate cofaces of a face lying two or more ranks below that simplex, so no unsupplied higher coface can obstruct a step. Inductively these are actual CW elementary collapses. Only vertex 0 remains, proving the geometric quotient claim and its consequences.
residual_risks: The independent program verifies the supplied collapse, not that every greedy algorithm or other CW model collapses. The C++ regeneration was not required for verification and was not run. No formal or external attestation is claimed.

value.rationale: The natural full symmetry of the smallest cube with this known noncontractible independence complex poses an ordinary quotient question the prior rational character cannot settle. A replayable elementary collapse completely resolves its ordinary integral and simple-homotopy behavior; it provides a precise benchmark distinct both from nontrivial topology upstairs and from the proper antipodal quotient. This is a meaningful exact invariant, not merely a rerun of rational ranks.
residual_risks: The criterion and collapse are specific to Q4 and to this orbit-cell structure. No broader collapse classification is established.
